segments.he: אָמַר אַבָּיֵי, תְּרֵי תְּנָאֵי קָאָמַר לַהּ: אִי מָטֵינָא לִמְדִינַת הַיָּם – לְאַלְתַּר לֶיהֱוֵי גִּיטָּא, אִי מִשְׁתַּהֵינָא בְּאוֹרְחָא תְּלָתִין יוֹמִין וְלָא אָתֵינָא – לֶיהֱוֵי גִּיטָּא. הִגִּיעַ לְעַכּוֹ וְחָזַר – דְּלָא לִמְדִינַת הַיָּם מְטָא, וְלָא אִישְׁתַּהוֹיֵי נָמֵי אִשְׁתַּהִי תְּלָתִין יוֹמִין – בָּטֵל תְּנָאוֹ.
segments.en: «Abaye said:» The husband was «saying» a statement including «two conditions to her: If I arrive in a country overseas,» then this «will be» a valid «bill of divorce immediately,» or «if I tarry thirty days on the way and I do not come» back home, this «will be» a valid «bill of divorce.» If «he reached Akko and returned, as he did not reach a country overseas and he also did not tarry for thirty days, his condition is void» and his wife is not divorced.

moves.cueHe: אמר אביי, תרי תנאי קאמר לה
moves.summary: two conditions, neither fulfilled; Akko need not be overseas
moves.about: Akko is in the Land; the husband made two conditions — reaching overseas or tarrying thirty days
